_note: Hand-picked tools that always appear in the list. build.py adds the newest few from the experiments manifest on its own; add a tool here to keep it for good. A screenshot for hover previews lives at shots/<last part of the URL>.jpg.

tools.title: New York, in Time
tools.dek: An interactive history of New York, from the Lenape to the present.

tools.title: The Everything Map
tools.dek: Click any spot in the city and get a full report on it: neighborhood, districts, representatives and more.

tools.title: NYC Grid Pulse
tools.dek: New York’s electricity in real time: demand, supply and price, from the grid operator.

tools.title: Harbor Motion
tools.dek: A live map of the ships, ferries and tugs moving through New York Harbor.

tools.title: A day on the police radio
tools.dek: Pick a precinct and a day and see what the 911 system logged, hour by hour.

tools.title: The permanent residents
tools.dek: A map of 594 cemeteries and burial grounds in the five boroughs, including the ones that no longer exist.

tools.title: Foreign-born America
tools.dek: Where America’s immigrants live, county by county, by country of origin.

tools.title: Every Building
tools.dek: Every building in New York, mapped by age, height and type.

tools.title: Graveyard of ideas
tools.dek: A century of mayoral campaign promises from the candidates who lost.

tools.title: CompStat in context
tools.dek: NYPD CompStat crime data, made easier to read and compare.

tools.title: NYC News Engine
tools.dek: Scans local news sources to catch New York stories as they break.

tools.title: Open Data explorer
tools.dek: 3,000-plus city datasets, mapped and searchable in plain English.
